scope: Corollary 10.4 (Full convergence and the odd-height normalization) of the manuscript “The Gaussian free field limit of integer Lipschitz heights with two-arc boundary data” (preprints/The-Gaussian-free-field-limit-of-integer-Lipschitz-heights-with-two-arc-boundary-data-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f0047faf78711628), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 63. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every t > 1, Hδ =⇒ m + √ v ΦD, Hδ − EHδ =⇒ √ v ΦD in H−t loc(D). (10.10) All finite joint test moments converge. In particular hδ − Ehδ σ =⇒ ΦD, σ = 2 √ v = 4π √ c∗ > 0. (10.11) The constant has the absolutely convergent finite-volume expression of Proposition 6.1; it is inde- pendent of D, a, b. The uncentered odd-height limit has mean 2m + 1, the harmonic extension of its prescribed values +1, −1.
